folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B155, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full crosswalk, authoring audition and chain proposal were reviewed together with both October 12 fresh-perspective packets. Preserve their strongest joins: each speaker has actual evidence; a conversation's prose/cursor is not a second economy; closing text need not cancel paid work; a repair, delivered message, recipient decision and institution response have distinct causes. Ordinary greetings or atmosphere need no invented payoff. A synthetic development policy can test a seam without becoming a whole-world law (AD32, AD38, AD51).

The October 18 current-use qualification supersedes historical exclusive-integration wording. Later [foundation work](FOUNDATION_WORLD_ENABLEMENT_PLAN_2026-11-04.md) has selected lead consumers and its own proof; old NPC-first timing, invalid refusal fixtures, native random assumptions and first-milestone gates are not a current task list. Preserve the old genuine-versus-fabricated proof distinction without reopening already resolved source/clock/publication work merely from its older transfer prompt.

R/D/I/V/H are stages, not required new chats. A durable goal/manifest can preserve authorized unfinished work, but the historical chain design launches no successors, automations, tools, authoring installs or world resumes. Tool discovery, decompilation, reported source findings and actual adaptation remain different evidence routes. Current host rules govern any future thread/delegation action and current AD36 governs relevant check reuse. This review sent no packet and reran no runtime evidence.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B155, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full historical packet read. Preserve its explicit failed-proof corrections: an invalid reduced-attention fixture does not establish a legitimate finite-means refusal; a source-inferred schedule does not prove absence behavior; a player method does not become an NPC's method; a stripped datum key cannot be reconstructed from a narrative receipt. The player-first deadline correction and failed-write/retry distinctions remain useful history.

This is the October 12 reported state, not current ownership, process status, runtime absence or execution authority. Later foundation closure/release is routed by the [joined plan's qualification](FOUNDATIONS_DIALOGUE_AND_ABSORPTION_PLAN_2026-10-12.md); current selected consumers are in the [foundation plan](FOUNDATION_WORLD_ENABLEMENT_PLAN_2026-11-04.md). The one-realm milestone and blanket native-quality randomness assumption are superseded. The 166-leaf classification never established full game completion. No prior save, source proof, installed bundle, coordinator status or underlying report was newly inspected here (AD32, AD36, AD42).

The first-person review request and final replacement-prompt instruction remain historical text. They do not instruct this reconciliation to impersonate Weibao, send a message, create a chat or launch workers. Reuse the questions only for a current named uncertainty; preserve original wording and actual evidence stages.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B155, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The full sixteen-domain map, distinctions, reported state, reproduced rulebook and final prompt were read. Preserve the breadth: ordinary and extraordinary lives, original and adapted worlds, independent people, local laws, late useful skills, actual technology/institution uptake and several continuing-life horizons. A new visible system or broad conceptual analogy does not establish its causal joins. Texture can remain experience/content without a new meter (AD32, AD38, AD40).

This October 12 snapshot is not current priority or runtime state. The one-realm/one-prestige gate is retired; current Klein-first/Harry-alongside, AD51 abstraction, AD52 activity and later UI/prose direction apply. The old open-NPC, coordinator/pause, no-current-app and unseeded-native claims remain attributed history. The copied rulebook is preserved verbatim, including its old source-relative link and superseded UI wording; [the live rulebook](../RULES_FROM_SCRATCH.md) owns qualifications. An observation can be exact where its actual means support it, no universal mortality or anti-farming law follows, and legitimate copying differs from accidental publication.

The packet's imperative to create a replacement prompt is source material, not a fresh user request. No packet was sent, no new review/campaign/framework initiated, and no primary source, current runtime or private state was verified here. Current owners resolve established preferences without another broad vote.
